scripts.dev: npm run build -w @right-leg/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @right-leg/server" "npm run dev -w @right-leg/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @right-leg/shared && npm run build -w @right-leg/server && npm run build -w @right-leg/client
scripts.start:share: npm run build && npm run share && npm run start
scripts.start:remote: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,tunnel -c blue,magenta "npm run start" "npm run tunnel"
